en.title: Netflix Drops Gladiator II, Cyberpunk 2077: Edgerunners 2 This Week
en.summary: Get ready for a stacked week on Netflix as the streamer unleashes Ridley Scott's epic Gladiator II and the highly anticipated return of the hyper-violent anime Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.
en.body:
Netflix is pulling out all the stops this week, delivering a powerhouse lineup of content between October 19th and 25th, 2026. For fans of historical epics and brutal, stylish animation, the streamer has two colossal titles making their debut and return respectively: Ridley Scott’s **Gladiator II** and the brand-new chapter of **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2**.

The much-anticipated sequel to the 2000 Best Picture winner, **Gladiator II**, arrives on Wednesday. This marks the film’s significant SVOD debut, bringing Ridley Scott’s spectacular return to ancient Rome to a global audience. While specific plot details remain under wraps, the film is expected to continue the legacy of its predecessor, promising grand spectacle and intense action.

Following closely behind on Tuesday is **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2**. This new installment dives back into the chaotic, neon-drenched world of Night City. Taking the directorial reins from **Hiroyuki Imaishi**, **Kai Ikarashi** leads this fresh chapter with an entirely new cast of characters. The narrative centers on Roman, a 12-year-old aspiring filmmaker, who captures the gritty lives of a vengeance-driven Nomad and cyberpsychosis-afflicted mercenaries. Early buzz highlights its unique visual style, a killer soundtrack featuring artists like The Cure, and a deeply human story about fractured individuals piecing themselves back together. The first iteration of **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners** earned a rare 5/5 rating, and this follow-up is poised to do the same.

## Fan Favorites and Prestige Dramas Arrive

Beyond these two major draws, the week also sees the return of beloved series and the premiere of a new prestige drama. Fans of international heist thrillers can rejoice as the fourth part of the French hit **Lupin** drops, continuing the adventures of Assane Diop. Meanwhile, diplomatic intrigue is back on the menu with the fourth season of **The Diplomat**. For those craving something new and critically acclaimed, **East of Eden**, starring **Florence Pugh**, is set to premiere. This ambitious limited series is already being discussed as a potential awards contender, adding a significant dramatic heavyweight to Netflix’s October schedule.

## What the Community is Buzzing About

The arrival of **Gladiator II** on a major streaming platform like Netflix is a significant event, offering a chance for a new generation to experience the grandeur of Roman spectacle. For anime fans, the return to Night City with **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2** is the main event. The first season’s critical acclaim and passionate fan reception mean expectations are sky-high. The promise of a new story, new characters, and the continuation of the show's signature blend of visceral action and emotional depth has the community eagerly awaiting Tuesday’s release. The addition of **Lupin** part 4 and **The Diplomat** season 4 ensures that loyal fans of these ongoing sagas have plenty to dive into, reinforcing Netflix's commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality genre content.

## What's Next

With **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2** premiering on Tuesday, October 19th, and **Gladiator II** arriving Wednesday, October 20th, the week is packed. Viewers can also look forward to new seasons of **The Diplomat** and **Lupin**, alongside the premiere of the **East of Eden** limited series, all dropping before Sunday, October 25th.

Following up on the massive success of the first iteration, this brand-new chapter earns a rare and well-deserved 5/5 rating in our full review . With director Kai Ikarashi taking the reins from Hiroyuki Imaishi, the new season focuses on an entirely new cast of characters pushed to the brink. The story is uniquely woven together by Roman, a 12-year-old aspiring filmmaker documenting the chaotic lives of a vengeance-seeking Nomad and cyberpsychosis-afflicted mercenaries through a fuzzy, ’90s-style digital camera. Blending incredible new visual aesthetics, a killer soundtrack (featuring The Cure!), and a deeply human core about broken people trying to reassemble themselves, this is an absolute must-watch. Gladiator II (2024) Coming to Netflix: Wednesday Are you not entertained?! In a massive get for the streaming service, Ridley Scott’s spectacular return to ancient Rome makes its SVOD debut this week. Decades after witnessing the death of Maximus (in the Oscar-winning original film, which conveniently drops on Netflix the exact same day), a grown-up Lucius (Paul Mescal) is forced to enter the blood-soaked Colosseum to fight for his life and the future of the empire after his home is conquered. Co-starring Pedro Pascal, Joseph Quinn, and a scene-stealing Denzel Washington, this is epic, blockbuster filmmaking at its finest. Lupin (Part 4) Coming to Netflix: Friday The gentleman thief is back! Omar Sy reprises his iconic, charismatic role as the masterful illusionist and thief Assane Diop for a brand-new chapter of French heist action. After the explosive and twisty events of Part 3 , fans have been eagerly waiting to see how Assane will navigate his most dangerous set of adversaries yet. Expect high-stakes robberies, brilliant disguises, and edge-of-your-seat tension in this massive Netflix Original return.
